# iru_threats_v2 (Data Source)

List detected threats using the v2 API, which provides enhanced performance and additional fields like severity and tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iru_threats_v2" "example" {
  statuses         = ["quarantined", "released"]
  severities       = ["critical", "high"]
  management_state = "managed"
}

output "threat_names" {
  value = [for r in data.iru_threats_v2.example.results : r.threat_name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of results to return.
- `management_state` (String) Filter by management state (e.g., `managed`, `unmanaged`).
- `offset` (Number) Number of results to skip.
- `severities` (List of String) Filter by severity (e.g., `critical`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `informational`).
- `statuses` (List of String) Filter by threat status (e.g., `quarantined`, `released`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))
